exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: The question only concerns St. Vincent regional hospital's received units. Other entities do not affect the hospital's stock.

exclusions.name: Elena Cruz (bank supervisor)
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule; her actions do not change the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Weekend collections (Saturday/Sunday)
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday; no collections occur on weekends.

exclusions.name: Hospital usage or transfusions
exclusions.why_safe: The question asks for units received, not units remaining after use. Usage does not affect receipt count.

exclusions.name: Spoilage or wastage
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence of spoilage; units are assumed usable as per collection rate. Spoilage would reduce stock but is not mentioned.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Tuesday (after Monday and Tuesday collections) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Tuesday shipment.
Whether the centre's stock at 4pm Thursday (after Wednesday and Thursday collections, minus Tuesday shipment) is at least 150 units to dispatch the Thursday shipment.
Actual units collected on Monday (9am-5pm) – average 12/hr gives 96 units, but actual may vary.
Actual units collected on Tuesday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) – average 12/hr gives 84 units, but actual may vary.
Actual units collected on Wednesday (9am-5pm) – average 12/hr gives 96 units, but actual may vary.
Actual units collected on Thursday from 9am to 4pm (7 hours) – average 12/hr gives 84 units, but actual may vary.
Whether the Tuesday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon. Dispatched at 4pm Tuesday, takes ~3 hours, so arrives Tuesday evening – received well before deadline.
Whether the Thursday shipment is received by the hospital before Friday noon. Dispatched at 4pm Thursday, takes ~3 hours, arrives Thursday evening – received well before deadline.
